title: Fireworky
description: A small Firework Mod made to enjoy an amazing Firework Show alone or with your friends.
body:
# **|Quick About|**

_This is a small Firework Mod made to enjoy an amazing Firework Show alone or with your friends._        
_Even more enjoyable with shaders._


![Priview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95e5d19a4c77259a7fce69b2fd853e31b8d526cd_0.webp)


# **|Features|**

_The Mod adds 9 new Items with different uses!_
_Placeable Rockets and Batterys need to be lighted with a Flint and Steel or with a Redstone Igniter placed under the Rocket/Battery._

![Priview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c502d1d9950913683f462b02a6f272c263599103_0.webp)
